# Rodentia
Humanoid rodents - resourceful, evasive, sneaky, but fragile.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Get poisoned by [color=#a4885c]Theobromine[/color] (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and [color=#a4885c]Allicin[/color] (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- Use claws for unarmed attacks, dealing Slashing and Blunt damage. - Smaller than humans and can fit in duffelbags.
## Special
- Can rummage in disposal chutes to dig up trash. - Can sneak underneath tables, but not under doors.
## Drawbacks
- Take [color=#ffa500]30% more Blunt damage, and 15% more Slash and Piercing damage[/color]. - Always trigger mousetraps, even when wearing shoes. - [color=#ffa500]Get hungry 33% faster[/color] than humans.
